review.notes: Fence balance scan plus whole-document word/4-gram diff of the OCR Markdown against extracted text of all 30 physical PDF pages; physical pages 1 and 5 were rendered (300 dpi crops) to verify the two patches. Most word-level mismatches are PDF-side hyphenated line-break splits, not OCR defects. The recurring 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025' banner and the arXiv sidebar stamp are intentionally absent from the OCR on every page and were left out. Appendix tables 4-8 and 10-12 were compared cell-by-cell against the print, including the print's own inconsistent caption spellings (CogvideoX/CogVideo-5b).
